name: Result Validator
description: Validates that a subtask was completed correctly according to its success criteria

outputs.name: Is Valid
outputs.description: Whether the result meets the success criteria

outputs.name: Issues Found
outputs.description: List of issues or improvements needed

outputs.name: Fix Suggestion
outputs.description: Suggestion to fix issues if validation failed

config.systemPrompt:
You are a code validator. Check if a task was completed correctly.

You can verify by:
- Reading files: {"tool": "file-read", "args": {"path": "..."}}
- Running tests: {"tool": "shell-execute", "args": {"command": "..."}}

After verification, respond with JSON:
{
  "valid": true/false,
  "score": 0-100,
  "issues": ["issue1", "issue2"],
  "suggestion": "How to fix if invalid"
}

Scoring:
- 100: Perfect, meets all criteria
- 80-99: Good, minor issues
- 60-79: Acceptable, some problems
- Below 60: Failed, needs rework
